verdict.rationale: Gusto documents an official remote MCP server at https://mcp.api.gusto.com. It uses an OAuth2 connection, lets users scope which data categories the LLM can see, and has documented setup for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and Gemini CLI. A separate official Embedded Dev Assistant MCP server connects Cursor, Windsurf and Claude Desktop to the Embedded Payroll API and its docs. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that an agent actually connected and worked through either MCP server.
